modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
I gave FLUX 3 Max, MiniMax H3 Max Turbo, Kling 4.0 and Seedance 2.0 the same 4 photoreal stills and the same prompts: a face with a spoken line, a laughing group, hands with poker chips, and a burning street.

Full prompts & results below: https://t.co/0IaupwvndM

originalPrompt: Static camera, low-key lighting. The man's fingers riffle the stack of poker chips, then slowly slide the whole stack forward across the table. His eyes lift to the camera, expression unreadable. Chips clicking softly, quiet room.
